metric_definitions.union_present_iou: Case macro IoU over classes present in reference or prediction; predicted-only classes contribute zero.
metric_definitions.boundary_f1_5um: Class-independent internal-boundary F1 with 5 micrometre tolerance; ignores class names.
metric_definitions.region_covering: Symmetric class-independent region covering from connected tissue regions; ignores class names.
metric_definitions.hd95_um: Symmetric 95th-percentile internal-boundary distance in micrometres; lower is better.
metric_definitions.per_class: Pooled positive-annotated-pixel TP/FP/FN; undefined if a class has no reference pixels.
metric_definitions.background: Unavailable: reference zero mixes glass, excluded and unannotated tissue.
